correctness.rationale: The specified unit-clock zero-temperature flips are equivalent to copying a uniformly chosen neighbor. Before coalescence two backward lineages have relative jumps at rate one in each direction; global resetting kills the relative walk at rate r with reward (-1)^n, while coalescence at 0 or N has reward 1. This gives the stated recurrence with no extra factor of two. Poisson renewal gives stationarity and first-reset coupling gives uniqueness; fair phase makes the one-spin means zero. The alternating particular solution and the bounded or two-boundary homogeneous solution give the exact kernels. The cosh ratio is strictly decreasing in r, and in n up to the midpoint; for fixed n the finite-image correction is positive and strictly decreases to zero with N. Bracketing the roots at the infinite root and any larger rate proves strict finite-size nesting and convergence. The odd infinite-chain equation gives u^m(u-1)=2. With t=kappa/2 and y=nt it yields y+log y=log n+o(1); since the derivative of y+log y is at least one, y-W(n)=o(1). This verifies the asymptotic and the fixed-rate sign-front scale. Fourier transformation of the normalized geometric periodization and (-1)^n gives the exact diffuse and Bragg terms.
residual_risks: Finite Fourier comparisons use floating-point arithmetic and serve only as corroboration; all-rate and infinite-volume statements are analytic. The sign front is a change in an observable, not a phase transition.

The exact nested odd-distance crossover identifies which pair observables change sign and how the ring modifies their crossing rates.
